elements_selected.content:
Add heading detection to src/search.rs (or a dedicated module). Implement per SPEC-013 §4.6:

Public API:
  - detect_headings(content: &str, body_text_ranges: &[(usize, usize)]) -> Vec<FileHeading>
    Scan line by line. For lines matching ^#{1,6}\s, check if the byte offset falls within a body_text_range. If so, record FileHeading { byte_offset, level, text }. Text is the heading stripped of leading # chars and trailing whitespace.
  - find_heading_for_offset(headings: &[FileHeading], byte_offset: usize) -> (Option<String>, Option<u8>)
    Binary search for the largest heading byte_offset <= the match byte_offset. Returns (heading_text, heading_level) or (None, None) if no preceding heading.

FileHeading struct: { byte_offset: usize, level: u8, text: String }

Headings inside code blocks, frontmatter, or HTML comments are excluded by the body_text_ranges filter (ADR-013-003). Setext headings are not detected (out of scope).

REQ-013-010, REQ-013-011, ADR-013-003.
